<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''Tamagami Number 3''' is the hammer-wielding guardian of the Third Demon World, the top floor of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. He is the first of the three Tamagamis you meet. When defeated he doesn't die: he drops the '''3-star Demon Realm Dragon Ball''' on his platform and goes back to sleep for an hour.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding the lair == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
Tamagami Number 3 sleeps on a stone platform on the Third Demon World. The lairs of the Tamagamis are searched for while players are in the Demon Realm. Once his lair has been located, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Time Patroller|Time Patroller]] in any demon village sells the '''Tamagami Number Three Map''' for 12 Emeralds (4 uses).

<!--T:10-->
He wakes when a survival or adventure player comes within 32 blocks of his platform, or when you hit him.
</translate>

<translate>
== How the Tamagamis fight == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Red circles and lanes on the ground always mark where a move will land. Some moves leave a Tamagami '''exposed''' for a moment: while exposed it takes '''25% more damage'''. When badly hurt, a Tamagami turns into its '''Powered Up''' form, which uses its moves more often (75% of the cooldown) and with extra follow-ups.
</translate>

<translate>
== Moves == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
* '''Hammer Throw.''' A boomerang hammer that comes back to his hand. He hits weaker while it's gone.
* '''Hammer Slam.''' He jumps and smashes the marked spot. Powered Up, he follows with a second slam. If the last slam hits nobody, his hammer gets '''stuck in the ground''' and he is exposed.
* '''Meteor.''' If you stay in the air, he appears '''behind you''' and spikes you down. A warning tells you when he is right behind you.
* '''Pillars.''' Rock pillars burst out of the ground under the marked spots and launch you (two waves when Powered Up).
* '''Cyclone.''' He spins toward you with his hammer, pulling everyone close. Afterwards he is '''dizzy''' and exposed.
</translate>

<translate>
== Defeat and rewards == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
When his health runs out, Tamagami Number 3 drops the '''3-star Demon Realm Dragon Ball''' on his platform and becomes dormant for an hour before he can be fought again. The three Demon Realm Dragon Balls, one from each Tamagami, summon [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]] in the Demon Realm. They never scatter on their own and no radar finds them (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]]).

<!--T:17-->
Every contributor with at least 7.5% of the points also rolls these default rewards (see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses#Rewards|how world boss rewards work]]):
* '''×90 Attributes''' (guaranteed; the amount scales with your contribution): half as Attribute Points and half as Training Points, like quest rewards (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Stats and Attributes#Attribute Points and Attributes rewards|Stats and Attributes]]).
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Tamagami Hammer|Tamagami Hammer]] (30%): a mace with slow, heavy blows.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:18-->

<!--T:19-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]], the quest '''Tamagami Number 3''' asks you to defeat him three times on the Third Demon World.
</translate>
